    Cardano vs Ethereum (ADA vs ETH)

    As of November 22, 2026 (Binance daily close): Cardano closed at $0.1448 and Ethereum at $1,724.33, so 1 ETH = 11,908.36 ADA.

    ⚡ Live ADA price ⚡ Live ETH price 🔁 Convert ADA to ETH

    ADA vs ETH: what the numbers show

    Ethereum's market cap of about $216.97B is 39 times Cardano's ($5.52B); they rank #14 and #2 of the 114 coins tracked here. Over the past year Cardano fell 64.2% and Ethereum fell 37.8%, a gap of 26.5 percentage points in Ethereum's favour. Cardano was the more volatile of the two over the last 30 days (71.7% annualized against 65.9%). Within the year, Cardano's largest fall between daily closes was 69.5% and Ethereum's was 53.3%. On November 22, 2026 Cardano was 69.2% below its 52-week high and Ethereum 48.6% below its own. In 4 of the last 12 complete months, Cardano did better than Ethereum. Measured against Bitcoin's daily moves over 90 days, Cardano had a correlation of 0.82 and Ethereum 0.93.
